reportHeader: Housing in Midtown (CD5) Housing Safe, quality housing is a primary driver of health. For example, the presence of pests can exacerbate asthma, public space design near residences can impact safety and mental health. Overall housing affordability, stability, and accessibility, are factors that impact both physical and mental health. Print Download (downloads a CSV file) Expand all
